goal: Implement a lightweight terminal-based Pomodoro timer with session management and signal handling.
architecture: The engine (Timer.Run) manages state transitions and countdowns via a Clock interface; the CLI (main.go) handles configuration, validation, and SIGINT cleanup.
review_focus: The 4-session cycle logic and long break trigger (S1, S2, S16)
SIGINT signal handling and the 'Completed N' count (S3, S6, S9, S22)
Duration validation for the 25h/24h upper bound and 1s lower bound (S4, S12, S13, S15)
ANSI escape sequence formatting for in-place updates (S5, S7, S8)
The requirement that interrupted sessions are not counted (S6, S21, S22)

tasks.title: Engine: Timer logic and transitions

scenarios.check: Given 4 completed focus sessions, the next transition from Focus to Break is a LongBreak
Verifies the complete sequence of Focus -> ShortBreak -> Focus -> LongBreak
Ensures output uses \r\x1b[K and correct labels like 'Session 1: 25:00'
Verifies output switches from 'Session X' to 'Break: MM:SS'
Verifies LongBreak uses 'Long break: MM:SS' label
Timer works correctly with 1-minute durations without skipping 00:00
Ensure 0 or negative durations are handled (per R15/R15 ambiguity)
After a long break, the next session is Focus Session 5 (resetting cycle count)
Immediately displays correct session and duration

spec_excerpt: R1 The timer must transition between focus sessions, short breaks, and long breaks according to the four-session cycle logic
tasks.notes: Implementation of Run() must use a Ticker or Clock.After. It must track elapsed time and update the Writer every second. It must increment completedFocus only when a focus session finishes.

tasks.title: Integration: CLI and Signal Handling

scenarios.check: SIGINT during long break prints 'Completed 4 focus sessions' and exits 0
Configuring 25h duration fails startup with error
SIGINT during focus session does NOT count the interrupted session
SIGINT prints \r\x1b[K to clear remnants before printing completion message
SIGINT during long break after 4 sessions shows 'Completed 4 focus sessions'
SIGINT at startup shows 'Completed 0 focus sessions'
Passing --focus 25h prints error to stderr and exits 1
Reporting multiple duration violations
SIGINT during focus session 3 shows 'Completed 2 sessions'
Direct check of flag parsing for 25h error
SIGINT during session 5 counts previous cycle's 4 sessions
SIGINT at t=1s counts 0 completed sessions
SIGINT 1s before end of session does not count it

spec_excerpt: R3 On SIGINT, the program must clear the current in-place status line, print exactly 'Completed N focus sessions\n'...
tasks.notes: Main must use signal.NotifyContext to catch SIGINT. It must parse flags, validate durations (1s <= d <= 24h), instantiate Timer, and call Run. On context cancellation, it must print the final message using \r\x1b[K.
